title: Optimize / Evals review 1:1 prep (regressions & A/B notes)
content:
Purpose: prep for 1:1 with Lena (applied ML lead) to triage the quality regressions from recent A/B and agree next steps. Quick, messy notes + action items.

TL;DR:
- A/B (prompt-v1 vs prompt-v2) on support-qa dataset shows accuracy drop: 72.4% -> 68.9% (delta -3.5pp).
- Hallucination rate up ~3.2pp (from 6.1% -> 9.3%) measured by automated heuristics + spot-check.
- Regression concentrated on long-context cases (>800 tokens) and multi-turn follow-ups.

Data highlights / checks done:
- Ran the A/B for 50k requests (same routing/window). Results: precision down, recall roughly same.
- Error slices:
  - long-context (>800 tokens): -6.8pp accuracy
  - multi-turn clarifications: -5.1pp
  - emails & legal prompts: consistent drop (more hallucinations)
- Confidence calibration shifted slightly (avg token prob down 0.04).
- No infra or latency anomaly in logs around rollout time (checked infra traces).

Suspected causes (working hypotheses):
1) Prompt-v2 introduced a shorter system instruction and moved some constraints into examples -> weaker constraint enforcement for long contexts.
2) KV-cache behavior with new kernel selection for long sequences -> subtle state corruption / truncated context in some paths. Needs reproduction.
3) Dataset drift: newer eval set includes more multi-step reasoning items not in training prompt examples.

Immediate asks for 1:1:
- Prioritize: reproduce locally with debug token-level traces for a handful of failure cases (I can take 3-5 examples).
- Decide whether to rollback prompt-v2 for hosted until fix (safety vs cost).
- If root cause looks model/runtime, schedule a deep-dive with serving-runtime + release-eng.

Proposed experiment matrix (quick):
- Replay failing requests with prompt-v1 and prompt-v2, logging KV cache contents and model inputs/outputs (4 buckets: short/long x single-turn/multi-turn).
- Add constraint enforcement test prompts to the eval suite (automated).
- Small canary: roll prompt-v2 back for long-context routes only and measure.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Alex: collect 20 high-signal failure cases (by 2026-03-06) + run local reproducer with token traces.
- Jamie Park: add constraint enforcement checks to nightly eval (JIRA-EVALS-2123) and turn on alerting for >2pp hallucination delta (by 2026-03-08).
- Lena: coordinate with serving-runtime to schedule a 2-hr triage if KV-cache looks implicated (tentative next week).
- Ops: (flag for 1:1) confirm whether any kernel changes were deployed in prod around 2026-02-28 -> Jamie to check infra changelog.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Be explicit about risk tolerance: for hosted customers we may err on rollback if user-facing integrity impacted.
- Ask Lena about surfaced telemetry improvements we requested last quarter (per-route token diffs).
- Keep product informed: potential rollback affects optimize recommendations and possibly billing reporting.

Open questions:
- Do we have golden-token-level traces for the long-context path? If not, we need to add lightweight sampling ASAP.
- Can we reproduce the hallucination locally with off-the-shelf quantized model used in dedicated pools?

Misc scratch:
- try prompt tweak: re-add explicit "Do not hallucinate; refuse if not sure" as a single-sentence system instruction -> quick A/B?
- consider short-term mitigation: boost refusal threshold for long-context routes (config flag).

Meeting agenda (10-15 min):
1) Quick readout of metrics and slices (2-3 min)
2) Present hypotheses + immediate experiments (4-5 min)
3) Decide rollback vs canary + owners (3-4 min)
4) Next steps / triage schedule (2 min)

End notes: keep doc iterative — will update with reproducer outputs and Lena's triage notes.
